local Contract = {
	CAPACITIES = {8, 14, 20},
	POWER_YIELDS = {1, 2, 3},
	POWER_COSTS = {40, 100},
	CAPACITY_COSTS = {30, 80},
	SELL_VALUE = 5,
	INTERACT_DISTANCE = 10,
	ACTION_COOLDOWN = 0.2,
	HARVEST_COOLDOWN = 0.65,
	NODE_CAPACITY = 6,
	NODE_RESPAWN = 6,
	GOAL_SOLD = 40,
}

return Contract

local World = {}

local function required(parent, name, className)
	local instance = parent:FindFirstChild(name)
	assert(instance, "Missing authored world object: " .. name)
	if className then
		assert(instance:IsA(className), name .. " must be a " .. className)
	end
	return instance
end

local function requiredBasePart(parent, name)
	return required(parent, name, "BasePart")
end

local function requireShardCluster(nodeId, node)
	local count = 0
	for _, child in ipairs(node:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("BasePart") then
			count += 1
		end
	end
	assert(count >= 2, nodeId .. " must contain two shards alongside its main crystal")
end

local function requireSurfaceLabel(signName, sign)
	local surfaceGui = required(sign, "SurfaceGui", "SurfaceGui")
	local textLabel = surfaceGui:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
	assert(textLabel, signName .. " must contain a readable TextLabel")
end

function World.resolve(root)
	assert(root and root.Name == "Forge_GenerationPilot", "World resolver requires Workspace/Forge_GenerationPilot")
	local world = required(root, "World", "Folder")
	local nodesFolder = required(world, "Nodes", "Folder")
	local nodes = {}

	requiredBasePart(world, "Ground")
	required(world, "Spawn", "SpawnLocation")
	for _, pathName in ipairs({"PathSpawn", "PathCross", "PathBeacon"}) do
		requiredBasePart(world, pathName)
	end
	for _, terraceName in ipairs({"TerraceWest", "TerraceEast"}) do
		requiredBasePart(world, terraceName)
	end
	requiredBasePart(world, "RampNorth")
	for _, archName in ipairs({"ArchLeft", "ArchRight", "ArchTop"}) do
		requiredBasePart(world, archName)
	end

	for index = 1, 6 do
		local nodeId = string.format("Node%02d", index)
		local node = requiredBasePart(nodesFolder, nodeId)
		requireShardCluster(nodeId, node)
		nodes[nodeId] = node
	end

	local sellSign = requiredBasePart(world, "SellSign")
	local upgradeSign = requiredBasePart(world, "UpgradeSign")
	requireSurfaceLabel("SellSign", sellSign)
	requireSurfaceLabel("UpgradeSign", upgradeSign)

	return {
		nodes = nodes,
		sell = requiredBasePart(world, "SellStation"),
		upgrades = requiredBasePart(world, "UpgradeStation"),
		beacon = requiredBasePart(world, "Beacon"),
		spawn = world:WaitForChild("Spawn"),
	}
end

return World

local Contract = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Forge_GenerationPilot"):WaitForChild("Contract"))

local Economy = {}

local function result(ok, amount, message)
	return { ok = ok, amount = amount or 0, message = message }
end

local function updateGoal(state)
	if not state.GoalComplete
		and state.TotalSold >= Contract.GOAL_SOLD
		and state.PowerLevel >= 1
		and state.CapacityLevel >= 1 then
		state.GoalComplete = true
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function Economy.newState()
	return {
		Carry = 0,
		Coins = 0,
		PowerLevel = 0,
		CapacityLevel = 0,
		Capacity = Contract.CAPACITIES[1],
		TotalSold = 0,
		GoalComplete = false,
	}
end

function Economy.apply(state, action, nodeRemaining)
	if type(action) ~= "string" then
		return result(false, 0, "Unknown action.")
	end

	if action == "harvest" then
		if type(nodeRemaining) ~= "number" or nodeRemaining <= 0 then
			return result(false, 0, "That node is empty. It will refill soon.")
		end
		local freeSpace = state.Capacity - state.Carry
		if freeSpace <= 0 then
			return result(false, 0, "Your bag is full. Sell your crystals first.")
		end
		local yield = Contract.POWER_YIELDS[state.PowerLevel + 1]
		local amount = math.min(yield, freeSpace, nodeRemaining)
		if amount <= 0 then
			return result(false, 0, "Nothing to harvest.")
		end
		state.Carry += amount
		return result(true, amount, string.format("Harvested %d crystal%s.", amount, amount == 1 and "" or "s"))
	end

	if action == "sell" then
		if state.Carry <= 0 then
			return result(false, 0, "Your bag is empty.")
		end
		local sold = state.Carry
		local coins = sold * Contract.SELL_VALUE
		state.Carry = 0
		state.Coins += coins
		state.TotalSold += sold
		updateGoal(state)
		return result(true, coins, string.format("Sold %d crystals for %d coins.", sold, coins))
	end

	if action == "upgradePower" then
		if state.PowerLevel >= 2 then
			return result(false, 0, "Pick power is already maxed.")
		end
		local cost = Contract.POWER_COSTS[state.PowerLevel + 1]
		if state.Coins < cost then
			return result(false, 0, string.format("You need %d more coins for pick power.", cost - state.Coins))
		end
		state.Coins -= cost
		state.PowerLevel += 1
		updateGoal(state)
		return result(true, 0, string.format("Pick power upgraded: harvest %d each time.", Contract.POWER_YIELDS[state.PowerLevel + 1]))
	end

	if action == "upgradeCapacity" then
		if state.CapacityLevel >= 2 then
			return result(false, 0, "Bag capacity is already maxed.")
		end
		local cost = Contract.CAPACITY_COSTS[state.CapacityLevel + 1]
		if state.Coins < cost then
			return result(false, 0, string.format("You need %d more coins for bag capacity.", cost - state.Coins))
		end
		state.Coins -= cost
		state.CapacityLevel += 1
		state.Capacity = Contract.CAPACITIES[state.CapacityLevel + 1]
		updateGoal(state)
		return result(true, 0, string.format("Bag upgraded: capacity %d.", state.Capacity))
	end

	return result(false, 0, "Unknown action.")
end

return Economy

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local namespace = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Forge_GenerationPilot")
local Contract = require(namespace:WaitForChild("Contract"))
local Economy = require(game:GetService("ServerScriptService"):WaitForChild("Forge_GenerationPilot"):WaitForChild("Economy"))
local World = require(game:GetService("ServerScriptService"):WaitForChild("Forge_GenerationPilot"):WaitForChild("World"))

local root = workspace:WaitForChild("Forge_GenerationPilot")
local authored = World.resolve(root)
local actionRemote = namespace:WaitForChild("Action")
local feedbackRemote = namespace:WaitForChild("Feedback")

local states = {}
local cooldowns = {}
local nodeState = {}
local originalNodeColors = {}

local validActions = {
	harvest = true,
	sell = true,
	upgradePower = true,
	upgradeCapacity = true,
}

local function send(player, kind, message, position)
	local payload = { kind = kind, message = message }
	if position then
		payload.position = position
	end
	feedbackRemote:FireClient(player, payload)
end

local function mirror(player, state)
	for key, value in pairs(state) do
		player:SetAttribute(key, value)
	end
end

local function setNodeVisual(nodeId, remaining)
	local node = authored.nodes[nodeId]
	if not node then
		return
	end
	local available = remaining > 0
	node:SetAttribute("Remaining", remaining)
	node:SetAttribute("Available", available)
	if not originalNodeColors[nodeId] then
		originalNodeColors[nodeId] = node.Color
	end
	node.Color = available and originalNodeColors[nodeId] or Color3.fromRGB(45, 48, 60)
	for _, child in ipairs(node:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("BasePart") then
			child.Transparency = available and 0 or 0.72
		end
	end
end

local function refill(nodeId)
	local data = nodeState[nodeId]
	if not data then
		return
	end
	data.remaining = Contract.NODE_CAPACITY
	data.refillPending = false
	setNodeVisual(nodeId, data.remaining)
end

local function depleteNode(nodeId)
	local data = nodeState[nodeId]
	if not data or data.refillPending then
		return
	end
	data.refillPending = true
	setNodeVisual(nodeId, 0)
	task.delay(Contract.NODE_RESPAWN, function()
		refill(nodeId)
	end)
end

for nodeId in pairs(authored.nodes) do
	nodeState[nodeId] = { remaining = Contract.NODE_CAPACITY, refillPending = false }
	setNodeVisual(nodeId, Contract.NODE_CAPACITY)
end

local function characterRoot(player)
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then
		return nil
	end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not rootPart then
		return nil
	end
	return rootPart
end

local function initialize(player)
	if states[player] then
		return
	end
	states[player] = Economy.newState()
	cooldowns[player] = { general = 0, harvest = 0 }
	mirror(player, states[player])
end

local function removePlayer(player)
	states[player] = nil
	cooldowns[player] = nil
end

local function process(player, action, nodeId, argumentCount)
	if argumentCount > 2 or type(action) ~= "string" or not validActions[action] then
		send(player, "error", "That action is not available.")
		return
	end

	if action == "harvest" then
		if argumentCount ~= 2 or type(nodeId) ~= "string" or not authored.nodes[nodeId] then
			send(player, "error", "Choose a known crystal node.")
			return
		end
	else
		if argumentCount ~= 1 or nodeId ~= nil then
			send(player, "error", "That action needs no node.")
			return
		end
	end

	local state = states[player]
	local timers = cooldowns[player]
	local rootPart = characterRoot(player)
	if not state or not timers or not rootPart then
		send(player, "error", "You must be alive to do that.")
		return
	end

	local now = os.clock()
	if now - timers.general < Contract.ACTION_COOLDOWN then
		return
	end
	if action == "harvest" and now - timers.harvest < Contract.HARVEST_COOLDOWN then
		send(player, "error", "Your pick is still recovering.")
		return
	end

	local target = action == "harvest" and authored.nodes[nodeId]
		or action == "sell" and authored.sell
		or authored.upgrades

	if (rootPart.Position - target.Position).Magnitude > Contract.INTERACT_DISTANCE then
		send(player, "error", "You are too far away.")
		return
	end

	if action == "harvest" and state.Carry >= state.Capacity then
		send(player, "error", "Your bag is full. Sell your crystals first.")
		return
	end

	local remaining = action == "harvest" and nodeState[nodeId].remaining or nil
	local beforeGoal = state.GoalComplete
	local outcome = Economy.apply(state, action, remaining)
	if not outcome.ok then
		send(player, "error", outcome.message)
		return
	end

	timers.general = now
	if action == "harvest" then
		timers.harvest = now
		nodeState[nodeId].remaining -= outcome.amount
		setNodeVisual(nodeId, nodeState[nodeId].remaining)
		if nodeState[nodeId].remaining <= 0 then
			depleteNode(nodeId)
		end
		mirror(player, state)
		send(player, "harvest", outcome.message, target.Position)
	elseif action == "sell" then
		mirror(player, state)
		send(player, "sell", outcome.message)
	else
		mirror(player, state)
		send(player, "upgrade", outcome.message)
	end

	if not beforeGoal and state.GoalComplete then
		send(player, "goal", "Crystal Hollow restored! Your beacon shines for you.")
	end
end

actionRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, ...)
	local argumentCount = select("#", ...)
	local action, nodeId = ...
	process(player, action, nodeId, argumentCount)
end)

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(initialize)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(removePlayer)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	initialize(player)
end

local HUD = {}

local PANEL_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(18, 25, 38)
local PANEL_ALT = Color3.fromRGB(28, 38, 56)
local TEXT = Color3.fromRGB(236, 246, 255)
local MUTED = Color3.fromRGB(166, 188, 208)
local CYAN = Color3.fromRGB(70, 225, 245)
local AMBER = Color3.fromRGB(255, 185, 78)
local VIOLET = Color3.fromRGB(169, 125, 255)

local function make(className, name, parent, properties)
	local object = Instance.new(className)
	object.Name = name
	object.Parent = parent
	for property, value in pairs(properties or {}) do
		object[property] = value
	end
	return object
end

local function label(parent, name, text, size, color, properties)
	local values = {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Text = text,
		TextColor3 = color or TEXT,
		Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
		TextSize = size or 14,
		TextWrapped = true,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
	}
	for property, value in pairs(properties or {}) do
		values[property] = value
	end
	return make("TextLabel", name, parent, values)
end

local function button(parent, name, text, color)
	local item = make("TextButton", name, parent, {
		BackgroundColor3 = color,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		AutoButtonColor = true,
		Text = text,
		TextColor3 = TEXT,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		TextSize = 13,
		TextWrapped = true,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
		TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
		Active = true,
		Selectable = true,
	})
	make("UICorner", "Corner", item, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)})
	make("UIStroke", "Outline", item, {Color = Color3.fromRGB(95, 116, 142), Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.25})
	return item
end

function HUD.mount(playerGui)
	assert(playerGui, "HUD.mount requires a PlayerGui")
	local previous = playerGui:FindFirstChild("CrystalHollowHUD")
	if previous then
		previous:Destroy()
	end

	local gui = make("ScreenGui", "CrystalHollowHUD", playerGui, {
		ResetOnSpawn = false,
		IgnoreGuiInset = false,
		DisplayOrder = 20,
		ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,
	})

	local main = make("Frame", "MainPanel", gui, {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 12),
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 340, 0, 282),
		BackgroundColor3 = PANEL_COLOR,
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.06,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
	})
	make("UICorner", "Corner", main, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)})
	make("UIStroke", "Outline", main, {Color = Color3.fromRGB(78, 130, 157), Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.15})
	make("UIPadding", "Padding", main, {
		PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 11),
		PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 10),
		PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 13),
		PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 13),
	})

	label(main, "Title", "CRYSTAL HOLLOW", 20, CYAN, {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 27),
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
	})
	label(main, "Subtitle", "Quarry loop  •  restore the beacon", 11, MUTED, {
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 27),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18),
	})

	local statsRow = make("Frame", "StatsRow", main, {
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 50),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 31),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	})
	local carryLabel = label(statsRow, "CarryLabel", "Bag  0 / 8", 16, TEXT, {
		Size = UDim2.new(0.52, 0, 1, 0),
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
	})
	local coinsLabel = label(statsRow, "CoinsLabel", "Coins  0", 16, AMBER, {
		Position = UDim2.new(0.52, 0, 0, 0),
		Size = UDim2.new(0.48, 0, 1, 0),
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
	})

	local tracks = make("Frame", "UpgradeTracks", main, {
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 84),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 47),
		BackgroundColor3 = PANEL_ALT,
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.18,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
	})
	make("UICorner", "Corner", tracks, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)})
	local powerInfo = label(tracks, "PowerInfo", "PICK  Lv 1  •  Yield 1", 11, VIOLET, {
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 3), Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -10, 0, 20), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
	})
	local bagInfo = label(tracks, "BagInfo", "BAG  Lv 1  •  Holds 8", 11, CYAN, {
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 2, 0, 3), Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -10, 0, 20), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
	})
	local powerNext = label(tracks, "PowerNext", "Next: yield 2  •  40 coins", 10, MUTED, {
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 23), Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -10, 0, 18),
	})
	local bagNext = label(tracks, "BagNext", "Next: 14 slots  •  30 coins", 10, MUTED, {
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 2, 0, 23), Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -10, 0, 18),
	})

	local goalLabel = label(main, "GoalLabel", "Beacon goal  •  Sold 0 / 40  •  Pick 0/1  •  Bag 0/1", 11, TEXT, {
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 137), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20), Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
	})
	local hint = label(main, "Hint", "Find a glowing crystal cluster nearby.", 11, MUTED, {
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 158), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 23), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
	})

	local actions = make("Frame", "Actions", main, {
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 185), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 42), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	})
	local harvestButton = button(actions, "HarvestButton", "E  HARVEST", Color3.fromRGB(24, 117, 132))
	harvestButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0); harvestButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.25, -4, 1, 0)
	local sellButton = button(actions, "SellButton", "Q  SELL", Color3.fromRGB(143, 82, 27))
	sellButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.25, 2, 0, 0); sellButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.25, -4, 1, 0)
	local powerButton = button(actions, "PowerButton", "1  PICK", Color3.fromRGB(77, 54, 132))
	powerButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 2, 0, 0); powerButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.25, -4, 1, 0)
	local capacityButton = button(actions, "CapacityButton", "2  BAG", Color3.fromRGB(39, 91, 116))
	capacityButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.75, 2, 0, 0); capacityButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.25, -2, 1, 0)
	label(main, "Footer", "E/Q/1/2  or  tap a button", 10, MUTED, {
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 234), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
	})

	local toastMessage = nil
	local toastUntil = 0
	local toastPriority = nil
	local destroyed = false
	local handles = {
		gui = gui,
		harvestButton = harvestButton,
		sellButton = sellButton,
		powerButton = powerButton,
		capacityButton = capacityButton,
		coinsLabel = coinsLabel,
	}

	local function setButtonState(item, available)
		item.Active = true
		item.AutoButtonColor = available
		item.BackgroundTransparency = available and 0 or 0.42
		item.TextTransparency = available and 0 or 0.35
		local outline = item:FindFirstChild("Outline")
		if outline then outline.Transparency = available and 0.25 or 0.7 end
	end

	function handles.render(stats, context)
		if destroyed or not gui.Parent then return end
		stats = stats or {}; context = context or {}
		local carry = tonumber(stats.Carry) or 0
		local capacity = tonumber(stats.Capacity) or 8
		local coins = tonumber(stats.Coins) or 0
		local powerLevel = tonumber(stats.PowerLevel) or 0
		local capacityLevel = tonumber(stats.CapacityLevel) or 0
		local totalSold = tonumber(stats.TotalSold) or 0
		local goalComplete = stats.GoalComplete == true
		carryLabel.Text = string.format("Bag  %d / %d", carry, capacity)
		coinsLabel.Text = string.format("Coins  %d", coins)
		powerInfo.Text = string.format("PICK  Lv %d  •  Yield %d", powerLevel + 1, ({1, 2, 3})[powerLevel + 1] or 1)
		bagInfo.Text = string.format("BAG  Lv %d  •  Holds %d", capacityLevel + 1, capacity)
		if powerLevel >= 2 then
			powerNext.Text = "MAX LEVEL  •  Yield 3"; powerButton.Text = "1  PICK MAX"
		else
			powerNext.Text = string.format("Next: yield %d  •  %d coins", ({1, 2, 3})[powerLevel + 2], ({40, 100})[powerLevel + 1])
			powerButton.Text = string.format("1  PICK  %d", ({40, 100})[powerLevel + 1])
		end
		if capacityLevel >= 2 then
			bagNext.Text = "MAX LEVEL  •  Holds 20"; capacityButton.Text = "2  BAG MAX"
		else
			bagNext.Text = string.format("Next: %d slots  •  %d coins", ({8, 14, 20})[capacityLevel + 2], ({30, 80})[capacityLevel + 1])
			capacityButton.Text = string.format("2  BAG  %d", ({30, 80})[capacityLevel + 1])
		end
		goalLabel.Text = goalComplete and "Beacon restored  •  Goal complete!" or string.format("Beacon goal  •  Sold %d / 40  •  Pick %d/1  •  Bag %d/1", math.min(totalSold, 40), math.min(powerLevel, 1), math.min(capacityLevel, 1))
		goalLabel.TextColor3 = goalComplete and CYAN or TEXT
		local remaining = tonumber(context.nodeRemaining)
		local nearNode = context.nodeId ~= nil
		local nearSell = context.nearSell == true
		local nearUpgrades = context.nearUpgrades == true
		if toastMessage and os.clock() < toastUntil then hint.Text = toastMessage
		elseif goalComplete then hint.Text = "The beacon shines again. Keep quarrying!"
		elseif nearNode and carry >= capacity then hint.Text = "Bag full — visit the amber SELL station."
		elseif nearNode and remaining == 0 then hint.Text = "This node is dim. Try another crystal cluster."
		elseif nearNode then hint.Text = "Crystal nearby — press E or tap HARVEST."
		elseif nearSell and carry > 0 then hint.Text = "Amber station ready — press Q or tap SELL."
		elseif nearUpgrades then hint.Text = "Choose PICK for yield or BAG for capacity."
		else hint.Text = "Follow the pale path to a glowing crystal cluster." end
		setButtonState(harvestButton, nearNode and remaining ~= 0 and carry < capacity)
		setButtonState(sellButton, nearSell and carry > 0)
		setButtonState(powerButton, nearUpgrades and powerLevel < 2 and coins >= (({40, 100})[powerLevel + 1] or math.huge))
		setButtonState(capacityButton, nearUpgrades and capacityLevel < 2 and coins >= (({30, 80})[capacityLevel + 1] or math.huge))
	end

	function handles.toast(message, priority)
		if destroyed or not gui.Parent then return end
		if toastPriority == "goal" and os.clock() < toastUntil and priority ~= "goal" then return end
		toastPriority = priority
		toastMessage = tostring(message or "")
		toastUntil = os.clock() + 3
		hint.Text = toastMessage; hint.TextColor3 = TEXT
	end

	function handles.destroy()
		if destroyed then return end
		destroyed = true
		if gui.Parent then gui:Destroy() end
	end

	return handles
end

return HUD

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

local Feedback = {}
local effectFolder
local goalHighlight
local activeTweens = {}
local baseButtonColors = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})

local function getFolder()
	if effectFolder and effectFolder.Parent then return effectFolder end
	local root = workspace:FindFirstChild("Forge_GenerationPilot")
	if not root then return nil end
	effectFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	effectFolder.Name = "LocalFeedbackEffects"
	effectFolder.Parent = root
	return effectFolder
end

local function pulseButton(hud, buttonName, color)
	if not hud or not hud[buttonName] then return end
	local button = hud[buttonName]
	if not button.Parent then return end
	local original = baseButtonColors[button] or button.BackgroundColor3
	baseButtonColors[button] = original
	local existing = activeTweens[button]
	if existing then existing:Cancel() end
	button.BackgroundColor3 = color
	local tween = TweenService:Create(button, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {BackgroundColor3 = original})
	activeTweens[button] = tween
	tween:Play()
	tween.Completed:Connect(function()
		if activeTweens[button] == tween then activeTweens[button] = nil end
	end)
end

local function pulseCoins(hud)
	if not hud or not hud.coinsLabel or not hud.coinsLabel.Parent then return end
	local label = hud.coinsLabel
	local originalColor = label.TextColor3
	local originalSize = label.TextSize
	local existing = activeTweens[label]
	if existing then existing:Cancel() end
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 236, 130)
	label.TextSize = originalSize + 4
	local tween = TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {TextColor3 = originalColor, TextSize = originalSize})
	activeTweens[label] = tween
	tween:Play()
	tween.Completed:Connect(function()
		if activeTweens[label] == tween then activeTweens[label] = nil end
	end)
end

local function harvestSparkle(position)
	local folder = getFolder()
	if not folder or typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then return end
	local orb = Instance.new("Part")
	orb.Name = "HarvestSparkle"
	orb.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	orb.Size = Vector3.new(0.35, 0.35, 0.35)
	orb.CFrame = CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, 2.2, 0))
	orb.Anchored = true; orb.CanCollide = false; orb.CanQuery = false
	orb.Material = Enum.Material.Neon; orb.Color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 235, 255); orb.Transparency = 0.1
	orb.Parent = folder
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Name = "CrystalBurst"
	emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(85, 235, 255), Color3.fromRGB(174, 115, 255))
	emitter.LightEmission = 0.8; emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.25, 0.55); emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(2, 5)
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(360, 360); emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.18), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.7, 0.1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0)})
	emitter.Parent = orb; emitter:Emit(18)
	TweenService:Create(orb, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Size = Vector3.new(1.1, 1.1, 1.1), Transparency = 1, CFrame = orb.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 1.1, 0)}):Play()
	Debris:AddItem(orb, 0.75)
end

local function ensureGoalGlow()
	if goalHighlight and goalHighlight.Parent then return end
	local root = workspace:FindFirstChild("Forge_GenerationPilot")
	local world = root and root:FindFirstChild("World")
	local beacon = world and world:FindFirstChild("Beacon")
	if not beacon then return end
	goalHighlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
	goalHighlight.Name = "LocalBeaconGlow"
	goalHighlight.Adornee = beacon
	goalHighlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(80, 225, 255)
	goalHighlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(190, 125, 255)
	goalHighlight.FillTransparency = 0.28; goalHighlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
	goalHighlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
	goalHighlight.Parent = beacon
end

function Feedback.play(payload, hud)
	if type(payload) ~= "table" then return end
	local kind = payload.kind
	if kind == "harvest" then
		harvestSparkle(payload.position); pulseButton(hud, "harvestButton", Color3.fromRGB(75, 190, 205))
	elseif kind == "sell" then
		pulseButton(hud, "sellButton", Color3.fromRGB(255, 172, 58)); pulseCoins(hud)
	elseif kind == "upgrade" then
		local target = string.find(tostring(payload.message), "Pick") and "powerButton" or "capacityButton"
		pulseButton(hud, target, Color3.fromRGB(151, 112, 245))
	elseif kind == "goal" then
		ensureGoalGlow()
		if not payload.steady and hud then hud.toast(payload.message, "goal") end
		return
	end
	if hud and payload.message then hud.toast(payload.message) end
end

function Feedback.destroy()
	for object, tween in pairs(activeTweens) do
		tween:Cancel(); activeTweens[object] = nil
	end
	if effectFolder then effectFolder:Destroy(); effectFolder = nil end
	if goalHighlight then goalHighlight:Destroy(); goalHighlight = nil end
end

return Feedback

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local scriptFolder = script.Parent
local HUD = require(scriptFolder:WaitForChild("HUD"))
local Feedback = require(scriptFolder:WaitForChild("Feedback"))
local shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Forge_GenerationPilot")
local Contract = require(shared:WaitForChild("Contract"))
local actionRemote = shared:WaitForChild("Action")
local feedbackRemote = shared:WaitForChild("Feedback")
local worldRoot = workspace:WaitForChild("Forge_GenerationPilot"):WaitForChild("World")
local nodesFolder = worldRoot:WaitForChild("Nodes")
local hud = HUD.mount(playerGui)
local connections = {}
local characterConnection
local destroyed = false
local goalCelebrated = false

local function connect(signal, callback)
	local connection = signal:Connect(callback)
	table.insert(connections, connection)
	return connection
end

local function snapshot()
	return {
		Carry = player:GetAttribute("Carry"), Coins = player:GetAttribute("Coins"),
		PowerLevel = player:GetAttribute("PowerLevel"), CapacityLevel = player:GetAttribute("CapacityLevel"),
		Capacity = player:GetAttribute("Capacity"), TotalSold = player:GetAttribute("TotalSold"),
		GoalComplete = player:GetAttribute("GoalComplete"),
	}
end

local function getRootPart()
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then return nil end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not rootPart then return nil end
	return rootPart
end

local function nearestNode(rootPart)
	if not rootPart then return nil, nil end
	local nearestId, nearestDistance = nil, math.huge
	for index = 1, 6 do
		local id = string.format("Node%02d", index)
		local node = nodesFolder:FindFirstChild(id)
		if node then
			local distance = (rootPart.Position - node.Position).Magnitude
			if distance < nearestDistance then nearestDistance = distance; nearestId = id end
		end
	end
	if nearestDistance <= Contract.INTERACT_DISTANCE then
		local node = nodesFolder:FindFirstChild(nearestId)
		return nearestId, node and (node:GetAttribute("Remaining") or Contract.NODE_CAPACITY) or nil
	end
	return nil, nil
end

local function refresh()
	if destroyed then return end
	local rootPart = getRootPart()
	local nodeId, nodeRemaining = nearestNode(rootPart)
	local nearSell, nearUpgrades = false, false
	if rootPart then
		nearSell = (rootPart.Position - worldRoot:WaitForChild("SellStation").Position).Magnitude <= Contract.INTERACT_DISTANCE
		nearUpgrades = (rootPart.Position - worldRoot:WaitForChild("UpgradeStation").Position).Magnitude <= Contract.INTERACT_DISTANCE
	end
	hud.render(snapshot(), {nodeId = nodeId, nodeRemaining = nodeRemaining, nearSell = nearSell, nearUpgrades = nearUpgrades})
end

local function request(action)
	if destroyed then return end
	if action == "harvest" then
		local nodeId = nearestNode(getRootPart())
		if nodeId then actionRemote:FireServer("harvest", nodeId) else hud.toast("Move closer to a glowing crystal cluster.") end
	elseif action == "sell" then actionRemote:FireServer("sell")
	elseif action == "upgradePower" then actionRemote:FireServer("upgradePower")
	elseif action == "upgradeCapacity" then actionRemote:FireServer("upgradeCapacity") end
end

local function onInput(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed or UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
	if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard or input.UserInputState ~= Enum.UserInputState.Begin then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E then request("harvest")
	elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Q then request("sell")
	elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.One then request("upgradePower")
	elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Two then request("upgradeCapacity") end
end

connect(UserInputService.InputBegan, onInput)
connect(hud.harvestButton.Activated, function() request("harvest") end)
connect(hud.sellButton.Activated, function() request("sell") end)
connect(hud.powerButton.Activated, function() request("upgradePower") end)
connect(hud.capacityButton.Activated, function() request("upgradeCapacity") end)
connect(feedbackRemote.OnClientEvent, function(payload)
	if type(payload) == "table" and payload.kind == "goal" then
		if goalCelebrated then
			payload = {kind = "goal", steady = true}
		else
			goalCelebrated = true
		end
	end
	Feedback.play(payload, hud)
	refresh()
end)

for _, attributeName in ipairs({"Carry", "Coins", "PowerLevel", "CapacityLevel", "Capacity", "TotalSold", "GoalComplete"}) do
	connect(player:GetAttributeChangedSignal(attributeName), function()
		if attributeName == "GoalComplete" and player:GetAttribute("GoalComplete") == true then
			if not goalCelebrated then
				goalCelebrated = true
				Feedback.play({kind = "goal", message = "Crystal Hollow restored! Your beacon shines for you."}, hud)
			else
				Feedback.play({kind = "goal", steady = true}, hud)
			end
		end
		refresh()
	end)
end

connect(RunService.Heartbeat, refresh)
characterConnection = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
	task.defer(function()
		if destroyed then return end
		refresh()
		if player:GetAttribute("GoalComplete") == true then Feedback.play({kind = "goal", steady = true}, hud) end
	end)
end)

task.defer(function()
	refresh()
	if player:GetAttribute("GoalComplete") == true then
		goalCelebrated = true
		Feedback.play({kind = "goal", steady = true}, hud)
	end
end)

script.Destroying:Connect(function()
	if destroyed then return end
	destroyed = true
	for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
	if characterConnection then characterConnection:Disconnect() end
	Feedback.destroy()
	hud.destroy()
end)

coverage.detail: The shared Contract module exports the exact approved economy, interaction, cooldown, node, respawn, and goal constants. Action and Feedback are declared once as RemoteEvents inside the shared ReplicatedStorage namespace.

Authored expert visual pass adds a circular quarry floor, layered cliffs, linked paths, faceted harvest clusters, merchant kiosk, workshop, beacon crown and planting. Original 35–45-entry benchmark budget intentionally superseded; original review/protected tests are historical evidence. Native visual acceptance remains pending.

Runtime node/station/spawn identities and horizontal positions preserved. Low paths connect the first loop; station boards use explicit CanvasSize and full-board labels. Native sign legibility, collisions and first-minute play remain pending.

Economy.apply clamps harvest yield to free capacity and shared node stock. Game validates living characters, known node IDs, proximity, cooldowns and shared stock, then decrements stock without allowing negative values and schedules a six-second refill with dimmed authored crystal parts.
Selling converts the entire server-owned Carry value at Contract.SELL_VALUE, clears the bag, increments TotalSold and rejects empty sales without mutation.
Power and capacity are independent level-two tracks using Contract prices and benefits. Purchases validate affordability and maximum level, deduct coins once, and update harvest yield or capacity.

GoalComplete is set only when the individual player's TotalSold reaches 40 and both upgrade levels reach one. The server emits one goal feedback event when the state flips while preserving ordinary play.

Game accepts only harvest, sell, upgradePower and upgradeCapacity, validates argument count, known node IDs, living characters, distance, cooldowns and server-owned state. Client-provided amounts, prices and rewards are not accepted.

Existing and newly joined players receive independent session state and all seven replicated attributes. Character respawns do not reset state, PlayerRemoving clears per-player state and cooldowns, and no persistence, monetization, HTTP, numeric require or uploaded asset dependency is used.

HUD.mount creates exactly one replaceable CrystalHollowHUD ScreenGui with the required named labels and four button handles. The returned render function consumes real supplied state snapshots, updates carry, coins, both upgrade tracks, prices, benefits, goal progress and contextual hints, and applies disabled-looking availability states for a compact responsive 340-stud panel suitable for narrow viewports. The returned toast and destroy functions remain scoped to this HUD instance.

Goal feedback now marks the local celebration as consumed when the server goal event arrives, preventing the replicated GoalComplete attribute callback from replaying the celebration. Sell feedback now visibly emphasizes CoinsLabel with a temporary color and size tween; all effects remain local and are cleaned up by Feedback.destroy.
